query: INSERT INTO whatsapp_app_state_mutation_macs (account_id, name, index_mac, value_mac, version) SELECT $1, $2, index_mac, value_mac, $5 FROM UNNEST($3::BYTEA[], $4::BYTEA[]) AS m (index_mac, value_mac) ON CONFLICT (account_id, name, index_mac) DO UPDATE SET value_mac = EXCLUDED.value_mac, version = EXCLUDED.version
